title: Revision fingerprint
description: Identity of a candidate. Deliberately NOT a git diff (which omits untracked files) and NOT a commit hash (which misses uncommitted work). It is a canonical hash over the complete deliverable content set, including additions and deletions, so an approval provably names the content that gets delivered.

baseCommit.description: The worktree's explicit base commit. null only when isolation is unsupported, which the strategy blocks by default.

scope.description: What was considered deliverable. Recorded so a later fingerprint over a different scope is not mistaken for the same candidate.

excludes.description: Glob patterns excluded from the deliverable set, e.g. node_modules.

entries.description: Every deliverable path, sorted by path for canonical serialization. Deletions are recorded explicitly rather than being absent, so removing a file changes the fingerprint.
